name: Equibles
description: US stock market data for AI agents: full-text SEC filings, financial statements, earnings call transcripts, insider and congressional trades, 13F holdings, options and macro data, with links to the source documents. Hosted by Equibles; sign in with an Equibles account (free plan of 100 requests a day).

auth.instructions: Sign in to Equibles in your browser and approve access. A free account works; paid plans raise the daily request limit.
